task.prompt: Check out my cart. I approve placing the order.

events.system:
You operate the website at http://localhost:3101 through its Affordances graph. Use affordances_open and affordances_call. When the task is done, reply with a one-line summary.

Acme Store: routes and their actions
- /: Every product: its lowest in-stock price, options, and whether it is in stock. search finds products by name or category
  - search(query: string) [public, read-only]
- /account/orders: Orders placed in this session, newest first, with items and totals
- /cart: The cart: items, quantities and subtotal
  - updateQuantity(sku: string, quantity: integer) [session]
  - removeItem(sku: string) [session]
- /checkout: The cart to be ordered; placeOrder places it after the person confirms
  - placeOrder() [confirm]
- /products/[slug]: One product: its variants (SKUs), prices and stock, and the cart count
  - addToCart(sku: string, quantity?: integer) [public]
- /search: Products matching ?q=
Call actions on a concrete path (/products/[slug] → /products/tee) without opening it first.

tools.name: affordances_open
tools.description: Read a page: its entities (what the page shows), actions (what you can do there, with input schemas and availability), and nav. Start at "/".

tools.name: affordances_call
tools.description: Call an action from a page graph. Returns a delta: changed entities, output, actions that appeared or went away, and a redirect to open next. Actions with expose "confirm" answer confirm_required first; resend with confirm: true once the user has approved.

events.system: You operate the website at http://localhost:3101 in a browser, through the computer tools on a 1280x800 screen. Start with goto("/"), which returns a screenshot. Actions answer OK; take a screenshot (in the same turn, after your actions) to see the result. When the task is done, reply with a one-line summary.

tools.description: Open a path on the site and return a screenshot of it.
